exposure: newborns who received antibiotics during birth hospitalization
outcome: antibiotic utilization (AU) rates for suspected neonatal sepsis (SNS)
cohort: >18 million infants from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Wide-ranging ONline Data for Epidemiologic Research database for the years 2016 to 2020
finding: There has been a gradual decline in AU for SNS in more than a third of US states in the last 5 years, with significant variation in AU rates by race and a significant association between chorioamnionitis and AU.
